features.title: Local Privacy Proxy & Sanitization Engine
features.user_visible_behavior: A startup operator can pipe raw log/feedback text through the local proxy and receive a sanitized, PII-free structural metadata object — with all emails, names, phone numbers, API keys, and JWT tokens stripped before any data leaves the local process.
verification: Feed a sample log containing synthetic PII (email, phone, API key, JWT) into the proxy.
Assert all PII patterns are absent in the output.
Assert the output contains only structural metadata (field names, data types, event frequencies).
Confirm no outbound HTTP call is made during processing (network intercept / mock).
Run the unit test suite for the sanitization module.
evidence: TestSanitizerOutput::test_output_contains_no_raw_pii PASSED — no PII values in metadata output
All PII types verified: email, phone, JWT, AWS key, Stripe SDK key, IPv4, generic api_key
features.notes: Uses regex + local NER (spaCy en_core_web_sm). NER degrades gracefully if model not downloaded. spaCy model not yet installed — NER entity counting will activate once 'python -m spacy download en_core_web_sm' is run. All core verification passes without it.

features.title: AI PM Triage Matrix & Relaxation Control Dashboard

verification: Load three sample anonymized metadata blobs into the triage dashboard.
Verify each item renders a Severity, Friction, and Sensitivity score.

Toggle 'Abstract Proprietary Logic' and confirm the preview panel updates.

features.notes: LLM call receives only anonymized structural metadata. Heuristic fallback runs without OPENAI_API_KEY. Frontend: Next.js dashboard at /startup with split-screen backlog list + relaxation controls panel.

features.title: Multi-File Workspace, Persistence & Public Test Runner
features.user_visible_behavior: A student opens a published challenge in a Monaco multi-file editor loaded from a starter scaffold (5 files). Edits autosave locally (IndexedDB) and to the server (anonymous workspace cookie). Syntax errors show red squiggles. Run executes public tests asynchronously without blocking the editor. Submit creates an immutable disk-backed snapshot (inline files or ZIP). Work survives browser refresh, tab close, and server restart.

implementation_order.title: Starter scaffold on publish + GET /starter + download ZIP
Replace SandboxTerminal with ChallengeWorkspace (Monaco + file tree)
draft_store.py + PUT /draft API + save status badge UX
Extend SubmitRequest to inline files + archive mode
Async public-test Run jobs + polling UI (run_jobs.py)

verification: Publish a challenge — verify starter scaffold (README, src/db.py, src/queries.py, src/main.py, tests/test_public.py) is generated and downloadable as ZIP.
Open challenge workspace — Monaco file tree loads starter; Python syntax highlighting works.
Introduce a syntax error — debounced validate API returns diagnostics; Monaco shows red squiggles; squiggle clears after fix.
Edit two files — refresh browser — both files restored from IndexedDB.
Edit file — clear IndexedDB — reopen workspace — server draft restored via workspace cookie.
Restart backend — draft still loadable from data/drafts/; save badge shows Saved after server ACK.
Submit inline multi-file project — submission snapshot written to data/submissions/; legacy single-file code still accepted.
Submit ZIP — path traversal and oversize archive rejected; valid ZIP stored.
Restart backend after submit — submission record and files still on disk; prior submission not mutated by later edits.
Click Run — editor stays editable — public test output appears via job polling.
Start second Run while first active — API returns 409 RUN_ALREADY_ACTIVE.
Run pytest backend/tests/test_draft_store.py backend/tests/test_run_jobs.py backend/tests/test_sandbox.py — all pass.
evidence: test_publish_generates_starter_scaffold PASSED — 5 starter files on publish
test_submit_multifile_inline PASSED — disk snapshot under data/submissions/
Frontend: ChallengeWorkspace with Monaco, IndexedDB autosave, run polling
features.notes: Merged Phase A (Student Workspace Design) + Workspace Persistence MVP into one feature. Build in implementation_order sequence — persistence slots in after Monaco/starter, not as a separate phase. Storage: data/drafts/, data/submissions/, data/jobs/ on local disk (no PostgreSQL/Redis for hackathon). Run uses subprocess + 30s timeout; Docker isolation deferred to assessor-001. Optional Phase A.5 (AI suggest panel) and Phase C (BYOK Cursor SDK agent) are out of scope for workspace-002. Deferrals: auth, cross-device sync, revision history, WebSocket streaming, Pyright/LSP in browser.
